_metadata.what_product_is_being_asked: For each decision below, confirm the selected wording is the right one to show. Every wording listed — selected and rejected alike — already exists in the live app; the live engine shows one or the other depending on the order the user tapped their symptoms.
_metadata.what_product_is_NOT_being_asked: Not to approve question CONTENT — that is a separate clinical and content review, still outstanding, and `content_approved` is false throughout. Not to approve publication. Not to approve activation.
_metadata.selection_rule_under_review: lowest_source_order_index — among the sources whose token was selected, the wording belonging to the alphabetically first canonical token id. Deterministic and independent of tap order. Accepted as the ENGINEERING proposal; this report is the product half.
